name: Lemon-Herb Mediterranean Chicken
desc: Lemon, garlic, and oregano chicken breasts roasted on one sheet pan with zucchini, cherry tomatoes, and red onion, served over brown rice.

source.evidence: Searched lemon herb Mediterranean sheet-pan chicken with zucchini, cherry tomatoes, red onion and brown rice; the close results (The Roasted Root, Averie Cooks, Little Sunny Kitchen) use thighs, olives or peppers and none shares this dressing and rice pairing.

ingredients.raw: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts (about 2 lb total)
1 medium red onion, cut into wedges

steps: Rice: combine the brown rice, broth, and a pinch of salt in a medium pot. Bring to a boil, cover, reduce to low, and simmer until the liquid is absorbed and the rice is tender, about 40 min. Take off the heat and leave covered 5 min, then fluff with a fork.
While the rice cooks, heat the oven to 425°F. Pound the chicken breasts to an even 3/4-inch thickness and pat dry.
Dressing: zest 1 lemon, then juice both. Set aside 1 tsp of the zest for the rice. Whisk the olive oil, lemon juice, remaining zest, garlic, oregano, thyme, 1 1/3 tsp salt, and pepper in a bowl.
On a rimmed sheet pan, toss the zucchini, cherry tomatoes, and red onion with about half the dressing. Rub the rest all over the chicken.
Push the vegetables to the edges and set the chicken in the center so it sits directly on the pan.
Roast until the thickest part of the chicken reads 165°F and the tomatoes have burst, 18-20 min.
Rest the chicken 5 min, then slice. Stir the reserved lemon zest into the rice. Serve the chicken and vegetables over the rice, topped with the feta and parsley.
tips: The earlier version of this recipe pulled the chicken at 160 to 162°F and counted on carryover during the rest; this one roasts to 165°F, the USDA safe temperature for chicken. Pounding to an even thickness keeps the breasts from drying out at that temperature.
